nodes.npcLine: Welcome to the airport! I am going to help you prepare your first journey.

playerOptions.text: I am going to check in and show my passport.
I am going to pack my suitcase first.

nodes.npcLine: Great! Your passport and ticket are ready. James York will be proud of your first journey.

playerOptions.text: I am going to find my gate. Thank you, Diana!

nodes.npcLine: Good plan. Pack your passport, ticket, and one change of clothes in your suitcase.

playerOptions.text: I am going to pack everything carefully.
